title: DO NOT BUY
text: DO NOT BUY. I cannot tell you what to do. Because I read all the reviews and I bought it anyway! I thought it cannot really be that bad. I WAS WRONG. The suction is really really bad. I let it sit on a piece of lint for approximately 2-3 minutes. It did not suction the lint up. I actually picked the lint up to see if it was stuck to the item. It was not stuck. I put the suction on my face, it was just air, not suctioning any thing. I tried to suction up some dust, the dust just stayed where it was. This is totally useless. I do not know how the company can sell this as a vacuum. I held a piece of debris  up to the nozzle and it did suction that up. But if I have to pick up everything and hold it up to the nozzle, that kind of defeats the purpose, don't you think? The battery does not really last 30 minutes, 10-15 at the most. But that doesn't matter if its not suctioning anyway. Buy at your own risk, I did and I found out the wrong way. Next time I will listen to the people who took the time to write the reviews. Do not buy.
